concerns_addressed: LoadTest.php performs real HTTP curl_multi requests at exactly 100 concurrent requests and fails on non-200/non-JSON responses plus p95 and maximum timings over the strict 2.0 second threshold; no fake timing or unconditional PASS path was found.
Without PERFORMANCE_BASE_URL and without explicit PERFORMANCE_LOCAL=true, the benchmark uses an explicit PHPUnit skip and does not claim a performance PASS.

PERFORMANCE_LOCAL=true was exercised and honestly reported 100 requests, 81 status/connection failures, approximately 10 second p95/max timings, and threshold_passed=false; the documented local SQLite/PHP built-in-server limitation matches this failure behavior.
ScaleFixtureSeeder generates 500 outlets with exactly 100 active outlets, five suppliers, 220 products, and 500 orders.

Marketplace supplier/product APIs are authenticated, bounded, paginated, and filter inactive suppliers and inactive products before pagination; supplier-less legacy products remain intentionally visible.
Full API tests passed (79 tests, 475 assertions, with only environment-conditional skips), the targeted marketplace/product tests passed, and the web test plus production build passed.

strengths: Marketplace responses use Cache-Control: no-store and feature coverage verifies supplier deactivation is immediately reflected, avoiding shared-cache leakage.
Queries select only listing fields, apply server-side page limits, use deterministic ordering, and add matching marketplace/latest-order indexes.
The change is bounded to the requested performance, marketplace, fixture, API, UI, and test scope; no premature broad rewrite was introduced.

Authentication remains enforced by the protected route group, inactive supplier/product filtering is SQL-side, and existing order/payment/authorization behavior remains green under the full API suite.
The benchmark emits structured evidence by path and rejects failures rather than converting environmental limitations into a false performance result.

issues.description: The marketplace UI requests per_page=50 and renders only the returned first page, but does not consume pagination metadata or provide next/previous/load-more controls; catalogs over 50 visible products or suppliers are therefore not reachable from this screen even though the API is correctly bounded.
